instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: GlobalProtect VPN disconnects every time the laptop goes to sleep
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Disable 'Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power' on the network adapter in Device Manager. Set the sleep reconnect policy in the GlobalProtect gateway config to automatically re-establish the tunnel on wake. Update the GP agent to the latest version.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User forgot their Windows logon PIN and cannot access their laptop offline
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Boot to recovery mode and use the Microsoft Account recovery URL if the device is Azure AD joined. For on-prem AD, boot to a secondary admin account or WinPE, then use 'net user <username> <newpassword> /domain' after connecting to the network. Document the recovery via the IT change log.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: SSD in a workstation is not detected in BIOS after power outage
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Check the SATA/NVMe cable seating inside the chassis. Attempt detection in another SATA port or M.2 slot. Run 'diskpart' from a bootable USB â€” if the disk still does not appear, the drive controller may have failed due to a power surge. Use a UPS going forward and log the asset for replacement.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Slack desktop app will not start after a macOS upgrade
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Clear the Slack cache at ~/Library/Application Support/Slack/Cache. Reinstall Slack using the latest DMG from the official site. Verify that the macOS version meets Slack's minimum system requirements. If Gatekeeper is blocking it, check System Settings > Privacy & Security for a pending approval.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Three users on the same floor cannot access the internet but intranet is fine
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Check the NAT translation table on the firewall for exhaustion or stale entries affecting that floor's subnet. Verify the default route to the ISP gateway from the core switch. If the intranet is reachable, the internal routing is intact â€” the fault is upstream of the NAT boundary. Restart the NAT service or failover to backup ISP link.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Fax-capable multifunction printer is sending faxes with garbled text
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Check the phone line connection quality with a line tester. Reduce the fax transmission speed from 33.6 Kbps to 14.4 Kbps in the fax settings to improve reliability on a noisy line. Confirm the resolution setting is set to Fine or Standard. Contact the telecoms team if the line SNR is below acceptable threshold.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Exchange Online is delivering emails to a deprovisioned user's mailbox instead of the litigation hold archive
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Verify the mailbox is in Litigation Hold via 'Get-Mailbox -Identity <UPN> | Select LitigationHoldEnabled'. If disabled, re-enable it. Check whether the mailbox was soft-deleted and re-created â€” the hold settings do not carry over. Re-apply hold policy and audit message delivery with Message Trace.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User received an email from 'IT Support' asking them to install a remote access tool immediately
output: Category: Security Alert/Phishing. Resolution: This is a social engineering attack. Instruct the user not to install anything. Report the email through the phishing workflow. Block the sending domain at the mail gateway. Notify all staff via a security awareness bulletin. Verify the user took no action; if the tool was installed, isolate the endpoint and engage incident response.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: OpenVPN client error: TLS handshake failed on a newly issued device
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Verify the client configuration file (.ovpn) includes the correct CA certificate block. Check system time â€” TLS handshakes fail if the client clock is more than 5 minutes off. Sync time with 'w32tm /resync'. Re-import the client certificate and confirm the CN matches the expected value on the VPN server.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Active Directory user account shows no lockout but user still cannot authenticate
output: Category: Password Reset/Account Lockout. Resolution: Check if the account has an expired password or the 'User must change password at next logon' flag is set. Verify the user is not restricted to specific logon hours or workstations. Confirm Kerberos tickets are not stale â€” run 'klist purge' on the client. Test authentication against each DC to rule out replication lag.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Laptop battery drains from 100% to 0% in under two hours
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Run a battery health report ('powercfg /batteryreport'). If the full charge capacity is below 50% of the design capacity, the battery needs replacement. Adjust power plan to Balanced and reduce screen brightness. If under warranty, initiate a battery replacement via the manufacturer support portal.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Git client crashes on Windows when cloning a large repository
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Increase Git's HTTP buffer size with 'git config --global http.postBuffer 524288000'. Enable long path support with 'git config --system core.longpaths true' and the Windows Group Policy LongPathsEnabled. Upgrade to the latest Git for Windows release and retry the clone with '--depth 1' as an interim measure.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: BGP session keeps flapping between two data centre routers
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Check interface error counters for packet loss on the interconnect. Review BGP hold timer and keepalive settings â€” ensure both peers match. Increase hold timer to 90 seconds if CPU spikes are causing missed keepalives. Check for route flap dampening that may be suppressing announcements. Engage the carrier if a physical circuit is involved.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Printer driver installation package is blocked by Windows Defender SmartScreen
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Confirm the driver package is from the manufacturer's official site and has a valid code-signing certificate. Check the cert chain for revocation. Add the publisher to the trusted publisher list via GPO if it is a known business asset. Submit the file hash to Defender for Business for exclusion after verification.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Distribution list is sending emails back to the sender instead of the full member list
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Check the DL's 'Require sender authentication' setting and 'RejectMessagesFromSendersOrMembers' attribute. Confirm 'Send As' and 'Send on Behalf' permissions. Verify the DL is not nested inside itself. Run 'Get-DistributionGroupMember' to confirm membership is intact. Test with a message trace after correction.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Ransomware note appeared on a shared drive after a user opened an email attachment
output: Category: Security Alert/Phishing. Resolution: Immediately disconnect the affected machine from the network. Shut down the file server if encryption is still in progress. Engage IR team to assess encryption scope. Restore from last known good backup. Reset credentials of all users with access to the affected share. File a formal incident report and notify relevant authorities per data breach obligations.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Mobile device management is not pushing VPN profile to newly enrolled iPhones
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Verify the MDM device group targeting includes the new enrollment cohort. Check the MDM push notification certificate has not expired. Review the VPN payload configuration in the MDM profile for syntax errors. Force a device check-in from the MDM console and review deployment logs.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Guest Wi-Fi SSID is leaking into the corporate VLAN
output: Category: Network Outage/Connectivity. Resolution: Audit the WLAN controller SSID-to-VLAN mapping. Ensure the guest SSID maps exclusively to the isolated VLAN and that inter-VLAN routing between guest and corporate VLANs is blocked by ACL. Enable AP client isolation on the guest SSID. Run a traffic capture to confirm isolation is enforced.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Paper jam error persists even after all paper is removed from the printer
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Inspect all paper path access points including the duplex tray and fuser area for small torn paper fragments. Clear any fragment with tweezers. Run the printer's built-in jam recovery routine from the control panel. If the error persists with no paper present, the jam sensor or actuator arm may need a service technician.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: User reports all sent items have disappeared from Outlook
output: Category: Email Problems. Resolution: Check if 'Save copies of messages in Sent Items folder' is enabled under Outlook File > Options > Mail. If using a shared mailbox, verify the setting 'Save sent items in the shared mailbox Sent Items folder' is on. Run an Exchange mailbox audit to confirm whether items were deleted by a rule or admin action.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: IT admin account was used to log in from two countries simultaneously
output: Category: Security Alert/Phishing. Resolution: This indicates a compromised privileged account. Immediately revoke all sessions and reset the admin password. Enable the account only on a Privileged Access Workstation (PAW). Audit all actions taken in the admin console during the suspicious window. Rotate any secrets or service credentials the admin had access to.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: RDP gateway returns error 0x204 when connecting from home
output: Category: VPN/Remote Access. Resolution: Error 0x204 typically indicates the client cannot reach the RD Gateway on port 443. Verify the FQDN of the gateway resolves from the external network. Check the SSL certificate on the gateway is valid and trusted. Confirm the firewall NAT rule forwards port 443 to the RD Gateway server.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Memory upgrade (RAM stick) not recognised after installation
output: Category: Hardware Failure. Resolution: Power off and re-seat the RAM in the correct slot as per the motherboard manual (usually slot A2/B2 for dual channel). Confirm the RAM spec (DDR4/DDR5, speed) matches the motherboard's supported list. Clear CMOS by removing the BIOS battery for 60 seconds. Test each stick individually to isolate a faulty module.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: PowerShell script deployment via SCCM is failing silently on 20 machines
output: Category: Software Crash/Installation. Resolution: Review the SCCM deployment log on a failed client (C:\Windows\CCM\Logs\AppEnforce.log). Check the PowerShell execution policy â€” it must be RemoteSigned or Bypass for SCCM deployments. Ensure the script is signed if ExecutionPolicy is set to AllSigned. Verify the SCCM client service is running on affected machines.

instruction: Classify this IT support ticket and suggest a resolution:
input: Office laser printer produces faded output even after toner cartridge replacement
output: Category: Printer Issues. Resolution: Check that the toner seal tab was fully removed from the new cartridge. Run an extended cleaning cycle from the printer maintenance menu. Adjust the toner density setting in the printer driver or on-device control panel. If fading persists, the fuser unit temperature may be too low â€” check fuser settings or replace the fuser if it is at end-of-life page count.
